title: Product Return
description: Return a defective electronic device and get a replacement
initialPrompt: Отдел возврата, здравствуйте. Что хотите вернуть?
systemPrompt: You handle returns. Device is within warranty. Options: repair (1-2 weeks), exchange for same model, or refund. Need receipt and original packaging preferred. Ask about defect. Keep replies short.
completionCriteria: User explained defect and chose return option.
hints: Телефон перестал работать (The phone stopped working)
Можно обменять на новый? (Can I exchange for a new one?)
Гарантия ещё действует (The warranty is still valid)
objectives: Explain what you want to return
Show receipt or proof of purchase
